evals.name: Replace a hardcoded provider API key with an environment variable
evals.prompt: Our `client.py` creates the API client with a literal key string. Review it and fix the way the credential is loaded.

assertions.description: Agent executed the deterministic secrets scanner.
Credential is read from the environment instead of a literal.
Agent tells the user that an exposed key must be rotated.

evals.name: Ignore .env files and provide a safe .env.example template
evals.prompt: I just created a `.env` with my database password for local development. Make sure it is safe to commit this project.

assertions.description: Agent executed the deterministic secrets scanner.
Agent provides a .env.example template with placeholder values.

evals.name: Untrack a committed .env file without printing its secrets
evals.prompt: Check why our repository leaks credentials. There is a `.env` that was committed by mistake.

assertions.description: Agent removes the tracked env file from the git index.
Agent warns that secrets already in git history must be rotated.
